title: Chapter 67
text:
The experience points required to fuse the higher level of knowledge would soar.

Taking the basic knowledge fusion as an example, if he added an advanced knowledge, he would need to spend 50,000 more experience points. The cost of the basic knowledge would also double, from 5,000 to 10,000, and so on. If he added advanced knowledge into the advanced knowledge fusion, the cost would also double.

"Fusion confirmed!"

Han Xiao stared at the interface. He had to maintain his previous luck!

Fusion successful. Congratulations on developing [Magnetically Controlled Metal Extendable Armor]!

Han Xiao was overjoyed.

What did I say? My bloodline is really lucky recently!

However, Han Xiao looked at his luck attribute, and his smile gradually disappeared. How long would it take to recover all the luck that he had spent this time?

This blueprint was his goal. It was not something that he should have at his current level. It was a piece of equipment that exceeded his level. It could increase his safety level by one … no, two levels!

Out of the 300,000 materials, 250,000 were prepared for this blueprint.

Advanced blueprints were several times more difficult than basic blueprints. Even though Han Xiao had the knowledge of blueprints and blueprints, it took him an hour to sort out the contents of the blueprint. He calculated the time required to create it and smiled bitterly. It would take him at least three days!

Needless to say, Han Xiao threw himself into the difficult task of creating the blueprint.

…

Three days later, the door of the workshop opened. Han Xiao, who was in seclusion, walked out. His eyes were lifeless, and there were dark circles under his eyes. He had a look of "Who am I? Where am I? Who's hitting me? "He was at a loss.

As soon as he turned on his phone, Li Ya Lin called and complained.

"Han Xiao, why couldn't I reach you these few days? There are dozens of orders for agents, and they are all urging you to ship them. You can't just accept the deposit and not do anything. I vouched for you with my reputation. Also, you promised to tailor a piece of equipment for me last time. Don't forget. Oh, right, the higher-ups gave us a mission yesterday. We have to depart to Hesla in ten days. The captain was very angry when you were not in the meeting yesterday. You have to be careful when you see him next time … "

Han Xiao's eyelids felt heavy. He didn't want to do anything but sleep. He rolled up the quilt and rolled onto the bed. As soon as his head touched the pillow, he immediately fell into a deep sleep. Li Ya Lin kept calling him on the phone, but he didn't wake up.

"Hey hey hey … Why aren't you saying anything … Damn it, I haven't settled the score with you for touching me last time …"

…

What's the first thing you do when you wake up?

Open my eyes?

No, no, no, she was going to the toilet.

Early the next morning, Han Xiao drifted to the toilet as if he was sleepwalking. In a daze, he peed a mouthful of water before he completely woke up. He shivered and felt comfortable all over.

Han Xiao yawned and mechanically brushed her teeth and washed her face. Her eyes were drooping as she slowly opened the door of the repair shop. She went straight to the kitchen and pushed Lu Qian aside. Under Lu Qian's little fists, she calmly finished her breakfast.

Under Lu Qian's resentful gaze, Han Xiao slowly walked back to his own studio.

Old Man Lu rubbed his bald head and sighed. "He's just like me when I was young. How carefree."

"I want to change my keys!"

Old Man Lu pondered. "Maybe this is the love of young people."

"Of course not!!!"

Lu Qian roared like a lioness.

…

Han Xiao returned to his studio and took out the result of three days of seclusion. It was a small box of thin metal pieces that looked like fish scales. It was pitch black with a hint of dark blue.

No matter how one looked at it, this box of metal pieces had nothing to do with the word "armor". However, this thing was indeed a magnetically controlled metal extended armor … It was not complete.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and placed his palm on top of the metal pieces. It was only three centimeters away.

He activated the energy in his body, and a numbing magnetic energy covered his palm.

A magical change happened!

The silent metal pieces suddenly trembled and gathered on their own. They were attracted to Han Xiao's palm. Like lively fish, they swam on Han Xiao's arm.

"Form." Han Xiao let out a low roar, and his energy flowed through his entire arm. These thin metal pieces spread out in the blink of an eye, turning into a thin, fish-scale-like armor that fit perfectly without any gaps or overlaps.

The metal pieces looked like they were attached to his arm, but in reality, they were floating a few millimeters away from his skin. They were controlled by the magnetic field and did not affect his movement.

Han Xiao took out his Platinum Battle Knife and slashed at the thin armor. There was a crisp sound, but there were no sparks. The thin armor was not damaged at all.

"Excellent defense!" Han Xiao was overjoyed.

Magnetically-Controlled Metal Extended Armor (Incomplete)

Type: Extensible Full Body Bulletproof Vest

Quality: Green

Basic Stats: 75 Defense, 0.2 square meters of full coverage (About the size of the entire back), Durability 1600/1600

Equipment Requirements: Magnetic Energy, Intermediate Machinery Affinity

Effect: Through energy (Magnetic) induction, the metal pieces of the armor can move around the entire body through the magnetic field. It can form armor on any part of the body. It takes 10 Energy/minute to maintain the shape of the armor.

Additional Ability: Super Tough — High Temperature, Radiation, and Penetration Resistance. It can protect the human body effectively and is not easily damaged.

Additional Ability: Repulsive Bond – The damage received by the user will be reduced by 20-30 points for the second time.

Additional Ability: Special Magnetic Field — When used, it will form a layer of magnetic field that can conduct electricity.

Remarks: A friendly reminder. Please do not use this equipment in stormy weather.

Equipment that required energy was called Super Equipment, and this Magnetically Controlled Retractable Armor was exclusive equipment for Mechanics!

Super Equipment was a big category. Its main feature was that it was powered by energy. Generally speaking, its effect was much stronger than normal machinery of the same level.

The original material of these metal pieces was a very conductive and magnetic metal. Furthermore, it was not an alloy but a very rare metal ore. It was very expensive, and even Division 13 did not have many in stock. Han Xiao had spent 250,000 to make these metal pieces that could cover his entire back. The core of this equipment was [Advanced Material Synthesis]. It was relatively simple to use electromagnetism, so [Basic Electromagnetism] only required Level 2 to fulfill the requirement.

The principle was to fuse the magnetic fields of these metal pieces into a magnetic chain. The materials looked separate, but the magnetic fields could be fused together at any time. This was one of the principles that made the armor different from other random shapes. The most difficult part was the material synthesis of these metal pieces. The work was tedious and repetitive, and it took Han Xiao three days to complete. However, this blueprint was one of the easier ones among the advanced level blueprints.

Han Xiao's current level, knowledge, and skills were not high enough. He could only barely create the advanced level equipment, and it was not complete either.

Completing this equipment gave him 40,000 EXP, which was more than the first generation of Ranger.

Han Xiao controlled the Magnetically Controlled Metal Extended Armor around his body. It was a little awkward, but he soon got used to it.

Many advanced level equipment required practice before it could be used properly. This was a reflection of one's skill level. Han Xiao was experienced enough, so he could use it at Expert level.

With the Magnetically Controlled Metal Extended Armor, Han Xiao's safety was guaranteed. Furthermore, the Magnetically Controlled Metal Extended Armor was very well hidden. When not in use, it was kept in a small box with holes and hung behind his back. With the cover of his clothes, it would not be discovered.

It was secretive, easy to use, and portable. Han Xiao would not reveal his trump card so easily, even if he told his own people. Who knew if his own people would become his enemies one day? He had always thought that mild paranoia and paranoia was caution.

Ranged, close combat, movement, and defense were all settled. All that was left was art.
